page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.large is an x86_64 architecture server powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. It features 1 physical core supporting 2 threads (2 vCPUs) and is equipped with 16.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The instance operates on a KVM hypervisor, includes a 48 MB L3 cache, and lacks local storage and GPU accelerators. Network connectivity is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate moderate single-core performance alongside limited multi-core scaling. The server achieves average ratings in stress-ng single-core CPU tests, Geekbench single-core scores, and single-threaded gzip compression. However, multi-core performance metrics, including Geekbench multi-core, stress-ng multi-core, and Passmark CPU scores, fall into the bottom 10% tier, reflecting the physical single-core limitation. Memory bandwidth tests for both small and large blocks also register in the lower percentiles, as do database operations and Redis SET throughput.

From a resource density perspective, this instance serves as a memory-optimized entry point, offering a high memory allocation relative to its compute footprint without the overhead of larger multi-core configurations. Given the single-core constraint and low multi-core benchmark ratings, it is best suited for memory-intensive workloads with low parallel processing demands. Suitable applications include lightweight caching, single-threaded text processing, basic web serving, and small-scale memory-bound utilities.
